# gravity_role_dhcp (Resource)

Configuration of the DHCP role.

~> **Warning** Applying this restarts the DHCP role. On Gravity 0.33.0 and earlier the role keeps using the context that was cancelled by the restart, so every subsequent write to `gravity_dhcp_scope` fails with `invalid argument: context canceled` until Gravity itself is restarted. Avoid managing this resource in the same configuration as DHCP scopes until that is fixed upstream.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "gravity_role_dhcp" "dhcp" {
  port = 67
  # Wait 30s for other instances to respond before offering a lease
  lease_negotiate_timeout = 30
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `lease_negotiate_timeout` (Number) How long to wait for other instances to respond before offering a lease, in seconds. Defaults to `30`.
- `port` (Number) Defaults to `67`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Role configurations are singletons, identified by the role name
terraform import gravity_role_dhcp.dhcp 'dhcp'
```
